A '''megacorporation''' was a type of corporation. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], megacorporations were responsible for the [[Galactic economy|commerce]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] used the assets of these corporations to fuel its [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] efforts.<ref name="TSoGG:LoW" /> One example of a megacorporation was the shipping company [[Interstellar Parcel Service/Legends|Interstellar Parcel Service]].<ref name="CSWE:IPS">{{CSWECite|II|108|Interstellar Parcel Service}}</ref> Another one is [[Galentro Heavy Works]] which, among other things, effectively ruled over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]], where the Empire reduced it's presence and let megacorporations rule freely over it.<ref>{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}}</ref>
